title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Poisson geometry and action-angle variables
exact_target: What prevents local Poisson action-angle charts from combining into one global system of angle, action and transverse coordinates?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100603 (AMR-020-0603). CC BY 4.0.

Alexey Bolsinov, Vladimir S. Matveev, Eva Miranda and Serge Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), Problem 6.5 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
